parameters.content:
## SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper
New job postings from any SmartRecruiters careers site since a date or window.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
